title: Satisfaction of gate clauses
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $u$ be an assignment of Boolean values to $n$ variables, let $b$ be a Boolean value, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on those variables. The clauses associated with $b$ and $cs$ are all satisfied by the assignment that gives each input variable its value under $u$ and gives each circuit gate the value of that circuit under $u$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables
